reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for ashwagandha, and that goes for any supplement. For the dose, and whether it makes sense for you at all, ask a doctor or a registered dietitian.

For general context, it's a popular herbal supplement, and the research on testosterone and stress is mixed and fairly limited. It can interact with some medications and conditions, which is another reason to run it by a professional first.

On the training side, sleep, eating enough, and steady progressive lifting do far more for how you feel and perform than any supplement. If you want, I can look at how your recovery and training week are shaping up.
